issues.claim: Category scope of the zone (whole town vs 'groups A')
issues.problem: The list contains no dentists, doctors, contractors/trades, retail or food businesses at all. Searches for dentists (Four Seasons Family Dental at 6 Auer Ct, East Brunswick Family Dental at 47 Brunswick Woods Dr, Nahel Yanni DDS at 385 Cranbury Rd) and roofers (Miraglia Contractors, Biondo Contracting, Skylight Roofing & Restoration, all East Brunswick) all return eligible local businesses that are nowhere in the list. Inference: 'groups A' means a category slice was assigned and trades/health were other teams' groups, but the mapper's category definition is not in my brief, so I cannot confirm the boundary. Counting only the categories the list covers, 26 of 35 eligible businesses my searches surfaced are listed (74%); counting dental and roofing too, it falls to 26 of 42 (62%).
issues.fix: Orchestrator should confirm the group-A category list. If the zone is meant to cover all non-excluded East Brunswick businesses, this list fails coverage and needs at least the dental and trades categories added.

issues.problem: Tectonic's own locations page gives 732-220-0606 for the East Brunswick office (197 Route 18 South, Suite 260 South). The ACEC member page actually opened does not show a phone at all, so 220-0303 is unsourced.
issues.fix: Use 732-220-0606 from the company locations page, or leave the phone out.

issues.claim: First Choice Loan Services Inc, 1 Tower Center Blvd Floor 18, (866) 970-3424
issues.problem: The address is right, but the lender's own site gives 732-536-3330, not 866-970-3424. It is also a mortgage-banking brand owned outside the area, so on the mapper's own franchise/branch rule it sits on the edge of the exclusion.
issues.fix: Confirm the local phone and make an explicit keep/drop call on the brand-branch question, as was done for other removed brands.

issues.problem: An East Brunswick chamber listing shows 'Schorpp Tax and Accounting Services, PC' at 330 Milltown Rd, Suite E12 with the same 732-387-2054 number, so the name/address pair in the list may be the stale half of one firm.
issues.fix: Check schorppcapital.com for the current office address and record one canonical name.

issues.problem: find-open.com/east-brunswick/attorneys returned HTTP 403 again from this checker, so roughly twenty entries that rest on a single FindOpen listing (many already marked 'unconfirmed') could not be independently re-read. This is a data gap, not a demonstrated error.
issues.fix: Before outreach, re-confirm the one-directory entries by phone or a second source; do not treat their addresses as reliable.
